blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Two times the quantity three x squared minus x, minus the quantity x squared minus five x, plus four times the quantity x minus three.

Distribute all three parts. Two times three x squared minus x is six x squared minus two x. The minus sign in front of the second parentheses changes both signs: negative x squared plus five x. And four times x minus three is four x minus twelve.
Now combine like terms. Six x squared minus x squared is five x squared. Negative two x plus five x plus four x is seven x. The constant is negative twelve.
So the answer is five x squared plus seven x minus twelve.
Watch out for these traps. If you change only the first sign, you get five x squared minus three x minus twelve. If you multiply only the x by four, you get five x squared plus seven x minus three.
